title: Cyberattack playbook: a checklist for employees | Kaspersky official blog
description: This analysis discusses how employees outside IT and security can inadvertently worsen cyberattacks due to lack of knowledge on proper incident response. It highlights real-world examples where attackers exploited human factors such as authority bias to bypass multi-factor authentication, employees failing to report phishing incidents leading to business email compromise, and victims executing malicious commands themselves. The post provides a checklist for employees to follow during cyber incidents, emphasizing immediate notification of security teams, avoiding self-remediation, disconnecting from networks, and not sharing unapproved information. It also stresses the importance of building a cybersecurity culture through ongoing training and awareness programs.
